expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Ninh Binh and Halong in the same five days gives you both kinds of karst country, the flooded fields and the open sea.
expert.tip: Do Ninh Binh before the bay. The rowing boats at Tam Coc are quietest first thing and the light on the water is better.

summary: Five days out of Hanoi: two nights in the old quarter with a full day south to the rowing boats of Ninh Binh and a cycle ride to Bich Dong pagoda, then an overnight cruise in Halong Bay and a last night back in the city.
included: Included: 4 nights with breakfast daily and dinner at the Hanoi hotel, one night on a cruise boat with lunch and dinner; private transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour; a private cycle ride to Bich Dong; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
